raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On the Apple Silicon MLX backend, hybrid-SSM models can fail when using the Mamba radix cache because `MlxAuxiliaryStateComponent` does not initialize all fields required by its inherited `MambaComponent` methods.

Unlike `MambaComponent`, the MLX implementation directly invokes `TreeComponent.__init__`, leaving the following fields uninitialized:

- `mamba_cache_chunk_size`
- `mamba_checkpoint_grid`
- `mamba_max_states_per_path`

When serving `mlx-community/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-4bit` with the `no_buffer` Mamba radix cache strategy, this results in:

```text
AttributeError: 'MlxAuxiliaryStateComponent' object
has no attribute 'mamba_checkpoint_grid'
```

The error originates from `finalize_match_result_in_tree_core`, where the inherited Mamba cache logic accesses the missing attribute.

This PR fixes the missing initialization to restore compatibility with the inherited Mamba cache logic.

Related to #32449 and #32450.

PR #32450 addresses broader MLX hybrid-SSM radix cache issues, including allocator compatibility and copy-on-write handling. This PR specifically addresses the missing initialization of `mamba_checkpoint_grid` and related inherited fields.

## Modifications

**1. Initialize inherited Mamba cache fields**

Updated `MlxAuxiliaryStateComponent.__init__` to initialize:

- `mamba_cache_chunk_size` from `slot.checkpoint_interval`
- `mamba_checkpoint_grid` using `math.lcm(slot.checkpoint_interval, params.page_size)`
- `mamba_max_states_per_path` from the runtime execution context

These values follow the initialization logic used by the base `MambaComponent`.

**2. Update existing MLX unit tests**

Updated the existing tests in:

- `test_attention_patching.py`
- `test_max_running_requests.py`

The tests now provide the required `page_size` and runtime configuration when constructing `MlxAuxiliaryStateComponent`.

**3. Add a regression test**

Added `test_auxiliary_state_initializes_mamba_cache_fields` to verify that all three inherited fields are initialized correctly.

The regression test was verified against both the original and patched implementations.

## Accuracy Tests

**Regression Test: Before vs. After**

Before the fix:

```text
FAILED test_auxiliary_state_initializes_mamba_cache_fields

AttributeError: 'MlxAuxiliaryStateComponent' object
has no attribute 'mamba_cache_chunk_size'
```

After the fix:

```text
PASSED test_auxiliary_state_initializes_mamba_cache_fields
```

**Unit Test Results**

Targeted MLX unit tests:

```text
56 passed, 19 warnings, 2 subtests passed in 5.47s
```

Broader MLX test suite:

```text
220 passed, 2 skipped, 19 warnings,
23 subtests passed in 12.51s
```

The broader test run excluded `test_quantization.py`, which requires downloading Hugging Face models.

**Real-Model Validation**

Environment:

- Hardware: Apple M5 Max, 128 GB unified memory
- Backend: SGLang MLX
- Model: `mlx-community/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-4bit`
- Mamba radix cache strategy: `no_buffer`
- Overlap scheduling: disabled

Results:

- Model initialization completed successfully.
- OpenAI-compatible Chat Completion requests completed successfully.
- Repeated requests produced consistent responses.
- Prefix cache reuse was observed.

The second request reported:

```text
#new-token: 45
#cached-token: 2176
```

No model forward logic or numerical kernels were modified. Therefore, no additional numerical accuracy benchmark was performed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

This PR fixes missing cache metadata initialization and does not introduce changes intended to optimize inference performance.

Prefix cache reuse was confirmed during functional validation, but no throughput or latency improvement is claimed.

  - Ruff import and formatting checks were performed. The full pre-commit suite has not been verified.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [[Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests)](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

  - N/A: No numerical kernel or inference performance changes. Functional validation results are provided above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [[guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance)](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
